ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.3). Adds a full-screen "Work Control" bottom tab laid out like the vanilla Work tab: one row per free colonist, a fixed pawn name column and a horizontal lane of movable WorkType cards, with one shared horizontal scroll and one outer vertical scroll. Each card has exactly two lines: the WorkType name on one line (ellipsized, full name in tooltip) and the best relevant skill level plus a temporary passion marker. Incapable WorkTypes are filtered out of the lane, the default order and the add picker, so they never appear or become draggable. On the first open the mod initializes once: an existing colony copies its current vanilla Work-tab priorities without writing, while a new/default colony gets a skill-based recommendation applied once; later new colonists and resurrected colonists are handled automatically. A Harmony hook captures edits made in the vanilla Work tab and rebuilds the stored per-pawn order. The first edit writes dense rank 1..N straight into each pawn's Pawn_WorkSettings priorities and calls Notify_UseWorkPrioritiesChanged. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
